slot.brief: Equilibrium with reversible gas-phase reaction; build ICE table from initial moles and degree of dissociation α to find Kp or equilibrium composition.

stem: Pure $\text{N}_2\text{O}_4(g)$ dissociates as $\text{N}_2\text{O}_4(g)\rightleftharpoons 2\text{NO}_2(g)$. At equilibrium, its degree of dissociation is $0.50$ and the total pressure is $3.0$ atm. Using pressures in atm, find $K_p$.

verdicts.working: For 1 mol initially, equilibrium amounts are 0.5 mol N₂O₄ and 1 mol NO₂. Their partial pressures at 3.0 atm total are 1 atm and 2 atm, respectively. Thus Kₚ = (2 atm)²/(1 atm) = 4 atm.

working:
Take initial $n(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4)=1$.
At equilibrium: $n(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4)=0.50$, $n(\text{NO}_2)=1.00$, $n_{\text{total}}=1.50$.
$p_{\text{N}_2\text{O}_4}=1.0$ atm; $p_{\text{NO}_2}=2.0$ atm.
$K_p=\dfrac{p_{\text{NO}_2}^2}{p_{\text{N}_2\text{O}_4}}=4.0$ atm.

Independent check: For 1 mol initially, equilibrium amounts are 0.5 mol N₂O₄ and 1 mol NO₂. Their partial pressures at 3.0 atm total are 1 atm and 2 atm, respectively. Thus Kₚ = (2 atm)²/(1 atm) = 4 atm.
